{"id":1993768557,"question_id":4297,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1777776840,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1993768557/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Primes Between Number and Its Reverse","memory":"9.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isPrime(int num){\n        if(num <= 1) return false;\n        if(num <= 3) return true;\n\n        if(num % 2 == 0 or num % 3 == 0) return false;\n        for(int i = 5 ; i*i <= num ; i+=6){\n            if((num % i == 0) or (num % (i+2) == 0)) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    int sumOfPrimesInRange(int n) {\n        string r = to_string(n);\n        reverse(begin(r) , end(r));\n        int rev = stoi(r);\n\n        int maxi = max(rev , n);\n        int mini = min(rev , n);\n\n        int sum = 0;\n        for(int i = mini ; i<= maxi ; i++){\n            if(isPrime(i)){\n                sum += i;\n            }\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-primes-between-number-and-its-reverse","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1966}
